article.title: The trial and humiliation of Sami Abu Shehadeh
article.author: Abdaljawad Omar
article.content: Palestinians with Israeli citizenship are no longer asked to pledge allegiance, but to renounce their own history. Palestinian Knesset candidate Sami Abu Shehadeh did exactly that before Israel's Supreme Court, and was pushed out anyway.
